criticalContextFinding.summary: This is not a from-scratch implementation gap. A single large commit (c8780618e, PR #1635, feat(customizer): complete saved-design editing and combat flow, merged 2026-09-10) authored the change folder (proposal/design/tasks/specs/REPORT.md) and landed roughly 6582 insertions of production source plus tests implementing essentially all six task lines in the same commit. The tasks.md checkboxes were deliberately left unchecked: both proposal.md (Existing OpenSpec task checkboxes and canonical specs remain unchanged) and REPORT.md (Task checkboxes remain unchanged until explicitly requested) state this is intentional, not incomplete work.
criticalContextFinding.consequence: The roadmap's planned / OPEN / receipt-null classification is checkbox-literal and technically correct, but it undercounts what already exists in source. R2.combat's real job is reconciliation and fresh verification (matching the node's own kind:verification tag), not net-new feature work: confirm each task's claimed behavior against current origin/main source and tests, re-run the four static gates and the relevant test matrix at the current tip (main has advanced several commits past c8780618e, including at least one campaign-authority projection change), and decide whether checkboxes and archival should now proceed.
criticalContextFinding.processAnomalyFlagged: openspec/specs/custom-unit-combat/spec.md and the custom-source clauses of openspec/specs/mission-contracts/spec.md (the source-of-truth specs) were created and modified by a separate commit f39c2b71c (docs(spec): clarify campaign combat catalog contracts, PR #1653, 2026-09-12), a docs-labeled PR, not the normal openspec-archive merge-on-completion flow, and it happened before this change's own tasks.md checkboxes were ever checked or the change was archived. This is a single-source-of-truth process irregularity worth flagging to the owner: the canonical spec already reflects this change's delta content while the change folder is still open with unchecked boxes. Not something this brief fixes; surfaced for the owner decision list.
